about.content_title:
What Shop Kloset realizes is to bring out people's hidden potential
and create a richer life.
We spare no effort to make the world full of smiles,
and create a Japanese society full of possibilities.
about.vision_comments: Enriching each person's life through apps and people to address various modern challenges
about.value_comments:
In order to create a better society where people and all living things can be happy,
we will never settle for the status quo, make no compromises, and always think and act one step ahead to realize it.

business.layout_title:
Maximizing people's potential through
the power of words we have built up so far
business.content_title:
Along with the rapid growth of technology, the world has become convenient.
On the other hand, it is also true that the number of people with tired hearts is increasing.
We continue to challenge everything to create days where your hearts are at peace and smiles never cease.

business.comments_list_1: Shop Kloset launched the Fairy Models Agency business to support the dreams of models who want to realize their dreams or who had given up on them.
business.comments_list_2: The Fairy Models Agency business supports activities in Japan for models residing not only in Japan but also overseas.
